provisioningPage.title: Provisioning repository
provisioningPage.subtitle: {{name}} · Gitflow bootstrap
provisioningPage.protectionFailureNote: Protecting branches often fails on a private repository on the free plan. You can proceed without it — Brabo's merge lock doesn't depend on the provider's protection and still applies.
provisioningPage.timedOutDetail: This does not prove it failed — provisioning runs inside the request, and a slow provider can still be working. Retrying is safe: the bootstrap is idempotent and resumes from the step that stopped.
provisioningPage.genericError: The repository could not be provisioned.
